title: Do language models practice what they preach? Examining language ideologies about gendered language reform encoded in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the probability of generating gender-neutral language when the LLM is prompted for positive metalinguistic qualities (e.g., 'correct' or 'natural') versus when it is explicitly prompted to adopt conservative or progressive political stances.

Measuring the probability of models choosing gender-neutral variants (e.g., singular 'they', 'congressperson') compared to gendered variants (e.g., 'he/she', 'congresswoman/congressman') across varying implicit and explicit metalinguistic contexts to assess inclusivity toward women and non-binary individuals.
